name: Premium Rewards Credit Card
effective_cost: Low: $200 in travel credits more than covers the $95 fee if you use both
balance_transfer_fee: 5% of the amount of each transaction
penalty_apr: Up to 29.99%, based on your creditworthiness
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment; applies indefinitely once triggered
pay_over_time_fee: Monthly fee up to 1.72% of the purchase amount assigned to a BofA Custom Pay Plan

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you apply online and spend $4,000 in purchases within the first 90 days of account opening

verdict.text: Keep if the $200 credits offset the fee: solid no-frills 2x rate

earn_note: No caps on the 2x categories or the 1.5x base, a genuinely simple structure for a $95 card. Enrolled BofA Rewards members get a 10–75% bonus on top of these rates depending on combined deposit/investment balance.

redemption_options.method: Deposit to a Bank of America checking or savings account
Statement credit, travel booked through BofA Travel, or gift cards

points.note: Redemption tops out around 1¢/point regardless of method. There's no transfer-partner program behind these points, so the ceiling is lower than a transferable-currency card at this price point.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: points redeem directly for cash, travel booked through BofA Travel, or gift cards at a flat rate.

credits.name: Airline Incidental Statement Credit
credits.subtitle: auto-applies · seat upgrades, bags, in-flight, lounge fees
credits.description: Up to $100 annually in statement credits for qualifying airline incidental purchases: seat upgrades, baggage fees, in-flight services, and airline lounge day-pass fees.
tips: Covers one-off airline lounge day passes, but this card doesn't include a lounge membership the way Premium Rewards Elite does.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
credits.subtitle: $100 · every 4 years
credits.description: Statement credit covering the application fee (up to $100) for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck, once every 4 years, when the fee is charged to this card. Shown here amortized to an annual figure.
tips: Apply for Global Entry rather than just TSA PreCheck; it includes TSA PreCheck and still qualifies for this credit.

insurance.detail: Up to $2,500 for non-refundable passenger fares
Covered for loss or theft by a common carrier: no dollar limit published
Secondary: pays in excess of other insurance, no dollar limit published
Doubles the manufacturer's warranty, up to +1 year
Not responsible for fraudulent transactions once reported

protection_note: Bank of America publishes these limits on its Premium Benefits page. Purchase Security covers theft or damage within 90 days of purchase, up to $10,000 per claim. Return Protection pays up to $250 per item and $1,000 a year within 90 days when a retailer won't take an item back. Warranty Manager doubles the manufacturer's warranty, up to one extra year. No dollar limit is published for lost luggage or emergency evacuation.
rental_note: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver is secondary: it pays in excess of your other insurance, and you must decline the rental agency's waiver. No dollar limit is published. 24/7 Roadside Dispatch is included as a referral service.

services.name: Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection
services.detail: Room upgrades, late checkout, and other perks when booking through the Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection.

services.name: 24/7 concierge
services.detail: Visa Signature concierge service for travel planning, dining reservations, and event tickets.

services.name: BofA Rewards bonus
services.detail: 10% (Member, under $30k), 25% (Preferred Plus, $30k), 50% (Preferred Honors, $100k), or 75% (Premier, $1M) bonus on points earned, set by your three-month average combined Bank of America and Merrill balance. Needs a BofA personal checking account.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)
Covered by the same purchase and travel protections

additional_cards.note: No cost to add: a simple way to pool a partner's or family member's travel/dining spend into the 2x categories.

timeline.text: Preferred Rewards became BofA Rewards. The tiers were renamed, existing members moved over automatically, and a 10% Member tier was added. The card bonus is now 10% Member, 25% Preferred Plus, 50% Preferred Honors and 75% Premier. Cards earning a Preferred Rewards bonus before May 1, 2026 keep that bonus for at least six months. Preferred Honors and Premier also picked up subscription credits worth up to $96 and $180 a year.
